title: HumaninFinder: A Hybrid AI Engine for the Evolutionary Discovery of Humanin-like Peptides
description: A professional bioinformatics tool for the discovery and classification of Humanin-like peptides (sORFs) using a Hybrid AI approach (ESM-2 + Biophysical analysis). It features an Evolutionary Rescue mode and an integrated AI Research Agent for expert interpretation.

creators.name: Menegidio, Fabiano Bezerra
creators.affiliation: LaBiOmicS, University of Mogi das Cruzes (UMC)
